description: List the ready-made task packs the household can add (e.g. moving house, a new baby, car maintenance): each pack's id, title, description and items (id, kind, title, whether it is selected by default, days before the anchor date, repeat interval). Packs for a vehicle, appliance or pet list the owned items they can be linked to (entities) with a suggested anchor date. Use it before apply_task_pack.
name: list_task_packs
